visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short dark hair in pigtails, wearing a pink cherry-print tank top and denim shorts, walks towards a man sitting at a white desk. She holds a white piece of paper. A graphic of a pink Otamatone is on the left. (2) The camera zooms in on the girl as she holds the paper, which has a crude drawing of the instrument on it. She gestures towards the drawing with her hands. (3) The man at the desk, wearing a white t-shirt and glasses, looks at his smartphone and laughs at the girl's actions. The background is a bright, modern indoor living space. (4) The girl stands in the middle of the room, looking at the man and holding her paper. She shifts her weight from foot to foot. (5) Adult hands enter the frame to help the girl hold the paper as she performs a bowing motion. (6) The scene shifts to a hallway where the girl continues to hold her paper and perform. Another young girl in a purple dress enters the background. (7) The main girl squats down on the wooden floor while looking at someone off-camera, still clutching her paper. (8) The girl stands back up and waves both hands at the camera with a small smile. (9) A final pink graphic screen appears with a small cartoon character and text.
